` [Highlight start] Over-the-counter "after-drinking" or hangover pills—often containing ingredients like dihydromyricetin (DHM), L-cysteine, B vitamins, electrolytes, or pain relievers [Highlight end] ` —do not prevent intoxication or protect your liver from alcohol damage. Clinical evidence proving that supplement-based hangover pills reliably cure or prevent hangovers is limited, and the FDA does not approve them to treat or prevent hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14EPSKrPHn3vMt40HwJRYFcrdABeS1OgK0VKj73ZZaHEh-7LFVRfjmFLDwfAPsteG06TG7kYwwIkX1fsfVo40JaGcDY2Hqrow03kdmFANrKHcqJRPCvs1oq1jUd3PYE8NPE4KP7DPECfKJ1nT3Ahclc7Z_DMTL7zn8Xj6DVgnA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX2qDrVd_A_3vzWdHevRHjnRbmyz6YFFMS_2nIMzwaFRvFz5EKcpvw7MtlrdLMGdx4IsS0FRdT7vIujVh4I-RZ3nRP_kIyUdXyQkhZyb2V33Bchv6o0EiJ6CPZwOU7G-k)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF11Yf7EKf-RUDm-9NP6YWO5m6ohmOVpESdodtMdG16F0OBiX6EH_DczlAlk3_TeuALuZusE1rGkX-A7jSMllL-kupC7JXkZoZ-rDxNCqB3DVeeJW-6vOl6bPT2DmyuYmLGGPhDQEbpjhPABReeSrm85pUx2r3v2IaPD_XrOAQr7P93afl)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXQl7gg7yn8GK6XBvNXOHfYembEUNppYfxc_szeJ2qTUnxeWXTlUpEwQWYJRrskPydo-FY2sxVhPROA4xMHTIgecBgx8NRPEGbfYIZJUpqhG--uBsG4RvIc_2uanpGIi4BEeUtwcbE)

### What to Know About After-Drinking Pills

- **Limited proof for supplements:** Ingredients like DHM, L-cysteine, prickly pear, and B vitamins are commonly marketed for recovery, but strong clinical backing for hangover prevention is lacking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14EPSKrPHn3vMt40HwJRYFcrdABeS1OgK0VKj73ZZaHEh-7LFVRfjmFLDwfAPsteG06TG7kYwwIkX1fsfVo40JaGcDY2Hqrow03kdmFANrKHcqJRPCvs1oq1jUd3PYE8NPE4KP7DPECfKJ1nT3Ahclc7Z_DMTL7zn8Xj6DVgnA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXQl7gg7yn8GK6XBvNXOHfYembEUNppYfxc_szeJ2qTUnxeWXTlUpEwQWYJRrskPydo-FY2sxVhPROA4xMHTIgecBgx8NRPEGbfYIZJUpqhG--uBsG4RvIc_2uanpGIi4BEeUtwcbE)
- **Symptom relief vs. cure:** Pills containing NSAIDs (like ibuprofen or aspirin) or caffeine may help ease headaches or fatigue, though NSAIDs can irritate the stomach lining—especially alongside alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14EPSKrPHn3vMt40HwJRYFcrdABeS1OgK0VKj73ZZaHEh-7LFVRfjmFLDwfAPsteG06TG7kYwwIkX1fsfVo40JaGcDY2Hqrow03kdmFANrKHcqJRPCvs1oq1jUd3PYE8NPE4KP7DPECfKJ1nT3Ahclc7Z_DMTL7zn8Xj6DVgnA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXQl7gg7yn8GK6XBvNXOHfYembEUNppYfxc_szeJ2qTUnxeWXTlUpEwQWYJRrskPydo-FY2sxVhPROA4xMHTIgecBgx8NRPEGbfYIZJUpqhG--uBsG4RvIc_2uanpGIi4BEeUtwcbE)
- **Avoid acetaminophen (Tylenol) with alcohol:** Combining acetaminophen and alcohol increases the risk of liver injury.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXQl7gg7yn8GK6XBvNXOHfYembEUNppYfxc_szeJ2qTUnxeWXTlUpEwQWYJRrskPydo-FY2sxVhPROA4xMHTIgecBgx8NRPEGbfYIZJUpqhG--uBsG4RvIc_2uanpGIi4BEeUtwcbE)
- **No liver shield:** No pill makes heavy drinking safe or prevents alcohol-related liver harm.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14EPSKrPHn3vMt40HwJRYFcrdABeS1OgK0VKj73ZZaHEh-7LFVRfjmFLDwfAPsteG06TG7kYwwIkX1fsfVo40JaGcDY2Hqrow03kdmFANrKHcqJRPCvs1oq1jUd3PYE8NPE4KP7DPECfKJ1nT3Ahclc7Z_DMTL7zn8Xj6DVgnA)

### More Reliable Ways to Recover After Drinking

- **Rehydrate:** Drink water or an electrolyte solution to replace lost fluids.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14EPSKrPHn3vMt40HwJRYFcrdABeS1OgK0VKj73ZZaHEh-7LFVRfjmFLDwfAPsteG06TG7kYwwIkX1fsfVo40JaGcDY2Hqrow03kdmFANrKHcqJRPCvs1oq1jUd3PYE8NPE4KP7DPECfKJ1nT3Ahclc7Z_DMTL7zn8Xj6DVgnA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXQl7gg7yn8GK6XBvNXOHfYembEUNppYfxc_szeJ2qTUnxeWXTlUpEwQWYJRrskPydo-FY2sxVhPROA4xMHTIgecBgx8NRPEGbfYIZJUpqhG--uBsG4RvIc_2uanpGIi4BEeUtwcbE)
- **Eat bland food:** Light carbs or toast can help settle your stomach and stabilize blood sugar.
- **Rest and give it time:** Only time clears alcohol and its byproducts from your body.
- **Watch for warning signs:** Seek urgent medical care for severe vomiting, confusion, slow or irregular breathing, extreme drowsiness, or signs of alcohol poisoning.

If you want to look into specific products, [Cheers Restore](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX2qDrVd_A_3vzWdHevRHjnRbmyz6YFFMS_2nIMzwaFRvFz5EKcpvw7MtlrdLMGdx4IsS0FRdT7vIujVh4I-RZ3nRP_kIyUdXyQkhZyb2V33Bchv6o0EiJ6CPZwOU7G-k) lists its DHM and L-cysteine capsule options and pricing, while [Kroger](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14shYm9zNBJ0AMtCbDFiKXXEldOCdpaRdtOcdI0NLTmDxB7mF9kMw--cUbV_J8q0dwukzjXjTUC3uHDUNxwqFH3yhsfWRhasa0BPNjPN_1raP_dVMtNgpcLDbYt3PxkzxdhL5XVEuoECy1P0pE5Oe_-nCjUMskdK_CvCuxiu-A) and [Amazon](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXgDZExydaEhr_r2Y2Ebh8UGDLVWVyh8hmzaF6eS13nXMiq07yd7LomdfNrzjMahPaVk_1FJ3u8qYiVD81McavxESFJpDPBLCcAXvuWUl_Z2PAy7GFQ81UdYGfjA) also carry listings for it.Are you asking about a **specific pill or supplement** (such as a hangover pill, pain reliever, or medication), or dealing with **symptoms after drinking** right now?
